english_adjudication.corrected_question: In what language did Debussy write his unfinished opera 'La chute de la maison Usher'?
english_adjudication.note: Confirmed via web search: Q369659 is Debussy's unfinished one-act opera (his own libretto, based on Poe's 1839 story but a distinct French-language musical work composed 1908-1917), not Poe's original English short story. The gold answer French is correct for the opera; the question's 'short story' framing pulls the reader toward Poe's English original. Fix: name the actual medium (Debussy's opera) instead of 'short story'.

english_adjudication.corrected_question: Who is credited with creating the painting of Laocoön housed at the National Gallery of Art?
english_adjudication.note: Confirmed via web search: El Greco's Laocoön (c. 1610-1614, National Gallery of Art, Washington) is an oil painting, not the ancient marble sculpture (Laocoon and His Sons, by Agesander/Athenodoros/Polydorus). Gold El Greco is correct for the painting; the question's word 'sculpture' names the wrong medium/wrong real-world artwork. Fix: say 'painting' instead of 'sculpture'.

Confirmed via web search: the Yash Chopra film Darr (starring Shah Rukh Khan, Sunny Deol, Juhi Chawla) was released 24 December 1993, not 1979. Gold Yash Chopra is correct; only the year in the question is wrong. Fix: correct 1979 to 1993 (needed to disambiguate from other films titled Darr, e.g. 1974).

english_adjudication.corrected_question: Who directed the 1952 film April in Paris?
english_adjudication.note: Confirmed via web search: the David Butler/Doris Day/Ray Bolger musical April in Paris was released December 24, 1952, not 1953. Gold David Butler is correct; only the year is wrong. Fix: correct 1953 to 1952.

Confirmed via web search: the Louis Malle/Donald Sutherland comedy Crackers (a remake of Big Deal on Madonna Street) was released February 17, 1984, not 1977. Gold Louis Malle is correct; only the year is wrong. Fix: correct 1977 to 1984.

english_adjudication.corrected_question: In what language is Cristiano Malgioglio's 2006 album Boleros recorded?
english_adjudication.note: Confirmed via web search: Wikidata Q3641710 is a 2006 studio album by Italian singer-songwriter Cristiano Malgioglio (a covers set of Cuban bolero standards), released on the Italian label MBO -- a specific Italian-language work, matching gold Italian. The current question's generic phrasing ('Boleros are often written in what language') invokes the Spanish-language bolero song genre in general, which would mislead a reader toward Spanish. Fix: name the specific work (the Malgioglio album) instead of the generic genre.

english_adjudication.corrected_question: Which company developed the 1997 Superman video game for the Game Boy?
english_adjudication.note: Confirmed via web search: the 1988 NES Superman was developed by Kotobuki System / published by Kemco, while the separate 1997 Game Boy Superman was developed by Titus (Titus Interactive). Gold Titus Interactive is correct only for the Game Boy version; the question wrongly conflates both platforms into 'the Superman video game for the NES and Game Boy' as if it were one game. Fix: restrict the question to the Game Boy version only.

english_adjudication.corrected_question: Who directed the 1948 film Woman Hater?
english_adjudication.note: Confirmed via web search: the Terence Young/Stewart Granger/Edwige Feuillere British comedy Woman Hater was released 13 October 1948, not 1964. Gold Terence Young is correct; only the year is wrong. Fix: correct 1964 to 1948.

Confirmed via web search (including the Wikidata entry Q1057697 itself, which is the 1965 film): the Luciano Salce/Vittorio Gassman Italian comedy Slalom was released 24 September 1965, not 1963. Gold Luciano Salce is correct; only the year is wrong. Fix: correct 1963 to 1965.
